m1-address.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/fingerprint/test_address.py FIRST: cell_key is a '|'-delimited join of all 6 fields (driver, era, vocabulary_version, class_id, channel, what_measure) in that order; each field raises a loud ValueError naming the offending field when None/empty/non-str; a value containing the delimiter raises; what_measure defaults to 'deficit', each RESERVED_WHAT_MEASURES slot ('push','managed','consistency','management_efficiency') is CONSTRUCTIBLE, an unknown what_measure raises; FINGERPRINT_CHANNELS == ('utilization','energy'); cell_key round-trips (same fields -> same key, differing field -> differing key). Then create src/physics/fingerprint/address.py: frozen dataclass CellAddress with the 6 fields, __post_init__ validating every field non-empty str with no delimiter plus what_measure membership in {default}+RESERVED_WHAT_MEASURES, a cell_key property, module constants CELL_KEY_DELIMITER='|', FINGERPRINT_CHANNELS=('utilization','energy'), DEFAULT_WHAT_MEASURE='deficit', RESERVED_WHAT_MEASURES=('push','managed','consistency','management_efficiency') -- until green (command-check c2).

m2-vocabulary.title: src/physics/fingerprint/vocabulary.py: ClassVocabulary + era_key + require_fittable
m2-vocabulary.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/fingerprint/test_vocabulary.py FIRST: k/class_ids length + uniqueness validation raises; f12_verdict must be one of PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIED else raises; require_fittable() raises ClassVocabularyNotFittableError on FAIL and on UNVERIFIED, passes silently on PASS, and an explicit override bypasses the raise on both FAIL and UNVERIFIED; era_key(season) is deterministic (same season twice -> same key), groups seasons sharing the same RegulationEra flag signature (era_key(2024)==era_key(2025)), and differs across a flag change (era_key(2013) != era_key(2015); era_key(2024) != era_key(2026)). m3-store.title: src/physics/fingerprint/store.py: DriverFingerprintStore (own db, k-cells-always, loud refusal, replace-on-rerun, no-fit-on-read)
m3-store.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/fingerprint/test_store.py FIRST (temp DB via pytest tmp_path only, #656): write_fingerprint(driver, era, vocabulary, channel, what_measure, observations) writes EXACTLY k rows (one per vocabulary.class_ids), a class absent from observations or below FINGERPRINT_UNRESOLVED_SUPPORT_FLOOR gets status='unresolved' (NULL mean/sigma), a class at/above the floor gets status='resolved' with its mean/sigma; get_fingerprint(...) returns EXACTLY k cells always (empty store -> k unresolved cells, never a missing row, never an exception from computation); INSERT OR REPLACE idempotency (writing the identical fingerprint twice leaves row_count==k, not 2k); replace-on-rerun (rewriting with a different mean updates the stored row in place); loud refusal (raise, no silent substitution) when era != vocabulary.rules_era on both read and write; loud refusal when write targets a (driver,era,channel,what_measure) that already has stored cells under a DIFFERENT vocabulary_version (vocabulary drift); loud refusal when vocabulary.f12_verdict != 'PASS' (propagated from require_fittable, unless an explicit allow_unverified override); loud refusal when what_measure is a RESERVED_WHAT_MEASURES slot; no-fit-on-read structurally (a read on a never-written store returns unresolved cells with no exception and no computation -- assert via inspecting the store module's own source that it imports no fit/pooling/observables module); must_exist=True on a nonexistent path raises FileNotFoundError before any schema work (mirrors the house pattern). Observe failure -- attest c1. Then create src/physics/fingerprint/store.py mirroring reference_utilization_store.py/grip_store.py's own-db pattern: sqlite3.Row factory, create-on-construct __init__(self, db_path, *, must_exist=False), _connect, _init_schema + _migrate_missing_columns (additive ALTER-ADD only), FORMAT_VERSION stamp, table driver_fingerprint_cells with cell_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL plus driver/era/vocabulary_version/class_id/channel/what_measure/mean/sigma/support_n/status/shared_floor_applied/format_version columns, write_fingerprint/get_fingerprint per above, a small FingerprintCell/CellObservation value shape for the write/read payloads, EraVocabularyMismatchError + ReservedWhatMeasureError exception classes -- until green (command-check c2).

postconditions.statement: TDD red: test_store.py written and observed failing (module absent) -- manual attest

constraints: OWN db (#632) -- never data/f1_data_*.db or the #664 observables db
tests use TEMP DBs only (pytest tmp_path, #656)
NO fit logic -- store never computes, only persists/returns stored rows
no import of the G3 fit module / driver_class_observables in this store
do not edit any existing module
